mapper.sql: a.ast05_tr_code_id AS tr_code_id , a.ast05_company_id AS company_id , a.ast05_tr_cd AS tr_code , a.ast05_tr_nm AS tr_name , a.ast05_rcv_pay_cd AS rcv_pay_code , f_cdnm('RcvPayCode', a.ast05_rcv_pay_cd, a.ast05_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS rcv_pay_name , a.ast05_tr_occ_type AS tr_occ_type , f_cdnm('TrOccType', a.ast05_tr_occ_type, a.ast05_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS tr_occ_type_name , a.ast05_item_class_group_cd AS item_class_group_code , a.ast05_finance_yn AS finance_yn , a.ast05_lock_yn AS lock_yn , a.ast05_use_yn AS use_yn , a.ast05_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ast05_tr_code a WHERE a.ast05_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.ast05_tr_cd || UPPER(a.ast05_tr_nm) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND a.ast05_asset_type LIKE #{assetType} AND ( ( #{useYn} = 'true' AND COALESCE(a.ast05_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) OR ( #{useYn} = 'false' ) ) ORDER BY a.ast05_tr_cd

SELECT a.ast05_tr_code_id AS tr_code_id , a.ast05_company_id AS company_id , a.ast05_tr_cd AS tr_code , a.ast05_tr_nm AS tr_name , a.ast05_rcv_pay_cd AS rcv_pay_code , f_cdnm('RcvPayCode', a.ast05_rcv_pay_cd, a.ast05_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS rcv_pay_name , a.ast05_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id , w.ast15_note AS note FROM ast15_tr_code_window w INNER JOIN ast05_tr_code a ON ( a.ast05_company_id = w.ast15_company_id AND a.ast05_tr_cd = w.ast15_tr_cd ) WHERE w.ast15_company_id = #{companyId} AND w.ast15_window_class_nm = #{windowClassName} AND COALESCE(a.ast05_use_yn,'false') = 'true' AND a.ast05_rcv_pay_cd LIKE #{rcvPayCode} AND a.ast05_tr_cd||a.ast05_tr_nm LIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY w.ast15_tr_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast05_tr_code (ast05_tr_code_id, ast05_company_id, ast05_tr_cd, ast05_tr_nm, ast05_rcv_pay_cd, ast05_use_yn, ast05_note, ast05_asset_type, ast05_finance_yn, ast05_lock_yn, ast05_tr_occ_type, ast05_item_class_group_cd) VALUES (#{trCodeId}, #{companyId}, #{req.trCode}, #{req.trName}, #{req.rcvPayCode}, #{req.useYn}, #{req.note}, '1', #{req.financeYn}, #{req.lockYn}, #{req.trOccType}, #{req.itemClassGroupCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE ast05_tr_code SET ast05_tr_cd = #{req.trCode}, ast05_tr_nm = #{req.trName}, ast05_rcv_pay_cd = #{req.rcvPayCode}, ast05_use_yn = #{req.useYn}, ast05_note = #{req.note}, ast05_finance_yn = #{req.financeYn}, ast05_lock_yn = #{req.lockYn}, ast05_tr_occ_type = #{req.trOccType}, ast05_item_class_group_cd = #{req.itemClassGroupCode} WHERE ast05_tr_code_id = #{req.trCodeId} AND ast05_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast05_tr_code (ast05_tr_code_id, ast05_company_id, ast05_tr_cd, ast05_tr_nm, ast05_rcv_pay_cd, ast05_use_yn, ast05_note, ast05_asset_type, ast05_finance_yn, ast05_lock_yn, ast05_ast_class_tree_id, ast05_dcr_class_tree_id, ast05_tr_occ_type, ast05_item_class_group_cd) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{companyId} , ast05_tr_cd , ast05_tr_nm , ast05_rcv_pay_cd , ast05_use_yn , ast05_note , ast05_asset_type , ast05_finance_yn , ast05_lock_yn , ast05_ast_class_tree_id , ast05_dcr_class_tree_id , ast05_tr_occ_type , ast05_item_class_group_cd FROM ast05_tr_code WHERE ast05_company_id = 0 AND ast05_tr_cd = #{trCode}
